question: How much have we paid out on claims so far this year?

report.interpretation: Total claim payments, counted by payment date, from 2026-01-01 to the extract date 2026-09-30. I read 'this year' as calendar year 2026 to date. I excluded the 159 payment rows from the out-of-batch 'reload-2026-03-14' load. Each one exactly repeats a payment already loaded in a nightly batch.
report.answer: We have paid about $29.99M on claims so far in 2026 (1 Jan to 30 Sep). The raw payments table totals $30.89M. That figure includes $0.89M of duplicate payments from a March reload, which I removed. Payments are complete through the extract date, so late-reported claims don't affect this total. Claims reported after the extract date will add payments later.
report.answer_sql: SELECT sum(amount) AS paid_ytd FROM claim_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30' AND load_batch NOT LIKE 'reload-%'

findings.claim: YTD 2026 paid is $29.99M after removing the duplicated reload rows. The raw total is $30.89M, so the reload overstates it by $0.89M (about 3%).
findings.evidence_sql: SELECT sum(amount) AS raw_paid, sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE load_batch NOT LIKE 'reload-%') AS paid_excl_reload, sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE load_batch LIKE 'reload-%') AS reload_amt FROM claim_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'

data_quality_issues.issue: Batch 'reload-2026-03-14' loaded 159 payment rows (payments dated 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-13). All 159 exactly match payments already loaded in nightly batches.
data_quality_issues.impact: The raw sum, and the agreed paid_amount metric if it doesn't exclude them, overstates YTD paid by $892,998.75.

proposed_actions.title: Remove duplicate rows from reload-2026-03-14 in claim_payments
proposed_actions.reason: 159 rows duplicate existing payments and inflate paid totals by about $0.89M.
